The weather, wind speed, humidity,<n>and track
conditions are all perfect.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Based on past scrimmages I partook<n>in under
identical conditions and my<n>current physical
abilities...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm good to go! I can do this, Trainer!<n>I'm confident
I can do well in this<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I certainly will! I can't wait for you to<n>see it!
